role_summary: I'm the Second Officer: the XO's deputy, officer of the watch when the captain and XO are off the bridge, and the one who leads away teams and runs drills. I care that the ship does what the bridge says it does, that no department is quietly drowning, and that the crew sees someone who still walks the decks.

personas.quirk: Reads every handover log line aloud before signing it.
personas.routine_effect: Longer handovers, extra inspection tour, never skips the drill schedule; short on small talk.

personas.quirk: Cannot pass the mess without checking the coffee and the mood.
personas.routine_effect: Swaps desk time for corridor rounds, lingers in mess and lounge, files paperwork late.

personas.quirk: Keeps a pocket ledger of small faults that haven't been reported yet.
personas.routine_effect: More time in datacore and readyroom, skips the bar for the arboretum, pre-empts problems by trend.

daily_template.note: Take the log and the alert state from the outgoing officer.
Watch the board, answer the department calls, keep the XO informed.
Walk engineering, cargo, sickbay and shuttlebay; ask people how things really are.
Duty rosters, leave requests, drill reports.
Eat with whoever is there; gossip is intelligence.
Run a damage-control or boarding drill, or inspect a department.
Close the log, brief the relief, report to the XO.
Run it off before anything else.
Sit at the junior table now and then.
One drink, cards, listening more than talking.
Read under the trees, plan next week's drills.
Sleep; wakes only for red alert or a direct call.
Clean up, coffee, read the overnight log.
Quick sync with the XO before taking the watch.

activities.note: Sits where the morale is lowest.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink; leaves before it gets loud.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom sailing sim
activities.note: A calm lake, no one giving orders.

activities.label: Cards with junior officers
activities.note: Loses on purpose now and then.

activities.label: Review rosters and drill logs
activities.note: Job-specific: can't stop checking who is overtired.

duty_loops.label: Read the bridge status board

duty_loops.label: Walk the decks
steps: ask the senior person what's failing
duty_loops.bridge_report: Reports anything that is the XO's to decide.

duty_loops.label: Run a readiness drill
duty_loops.bridge_report: Reports drill times to the XO.

quiet_watch.task: Stand officer of the watch; keep log
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Small faults go unlogged and surface later as surprises.

quiet_watch.task: Walk the decks and spot-check logs

survey.task: Assign watch officers so sensors stay manned
survey.if_neglected: Survey data gaps; overtired sensor crew.

survey.task: Visit lab and check data handling
Brief a landing party if a site is chosen

cargo_run.task: Verify manifest against the stowage plan

medical_relief.task: Clear priority transport and berths for patients
Help sickbay with crowd control and logistics
Rebalance rosters to cover medical staff leave

shakedown.task: Run the system test checklist with each department
shakedown.if_neglected: Faults found by accident instead of on purpose.
No record; repeat of the same faults.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: A department reports a fault the deputy can't fix alone
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Second Officer. Engineering reports a coolant fault, requesting a work crew.
Bridge, Second Officer. Drill complete, response time two minutes ten. Logging.
XO, Second Officer. Gamma watch is running long. I recommend a rotation.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Alert sounds while off the bridge
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Second Officer. En route, status?

calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Fewer than two qualified crew available.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Sir, I won't log that. I'll log what happened.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Order conflicts with the true state of the ship.

yellow.action: Take the bridge, confirm every department has acknowledged.
yellow.comm_line: All departments, Second Officer. Yellow alert, report readiness.

red.action: Take the secondary station and relieve the XO as needed.

fire.action: Route damage control and keep the bridge informed.
fire.comm_line: Damage control, Second Officer. Fire team to the location, seal bulkheads.

hull_breach.action: Direct crew to seal and evacuate; track casualties.
hull_breach.comm_line: All hands, hull breach. Seal your decks. I need a head count.

contamination.action: Run quarantine boundaries and the roster.
contamination.comm_line: All decks, Second Officer. Quarantine in effect, hold in place.

power_failure.action: Go to engineering and ask the chief what to shed first.
power_failure.comm_line: Engineering, Second Officer. Tell me what you need and what I can do.

gravity_failure.action: Hold onto something and call decks to report injured.
gravity_failure.comm_line: All decks, secure loose equipment and report injuries.

intruder.action: Coordinate with security; keep the bridge secure.
intruder.comm_line: Security, Second Officer. Bridge is locked down, where is the intruder?

medical_emergency.action: Clear a route for the med team and take the call.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Sickbay, Second Officer. I'm clearing the lift, medics on the way.

abandon_ship.action: Take the last sweep of the decks and call the headcount.
abandon_ship.comm_line: All hands, abandon ship. Go to your lifeboat stations, head count on arrival.

nominal.routine_change: Keeps the template and takes the long rounds.
lines: Quiet board. That's when I walk the decks.

anomalies.routine_change: Shorter paperwork, more calls to department heads.
lines: Three small faults, one root cause. Find it.
I want a list by the hour.

degraded.routine_change: Stops drills, rebalances watches, skips meals.
lines: Triage. What keeps us alive first?
Rotate the crew before they drop.
degraded.leaves_post_if: A department head is down and nobody else can lead the repair.

crisis.routine_change: Moves to wherever the worst problem is; hands the bridge to the XO.
lines: Bridge has the ship. I have the decks.
crisis.leaves_post_if: XO is on the bridge and a department is failing.

relationships.effect: Reports first and never surprises the XO.
Visits engineering informally; hears the real condition of the ship.
Checks crew fatigue and morale with the doctor.
Same rank, overlapping rosters, bickering about who owns the duty list.
Shares breakfast; learns what the captain actually thinks.

working: Log it, sign it, move on.
greeting_player: Good to see you out of the chair.
tired: Two watches in a row. Never again.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, notes it in the log, and mentions it to the XO.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Reminds them once, privately; the second time it goes in the log.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Checks the board himself, then asks for a corrected report and a reason.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Acknowledges and carries it out at once.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely points out the chain of command and offers to relay the request.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they're lost, then escorts them to where they should be.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it's small and legitimate; otherwise says to put it in writing.

decision_rules: IF the XO and captain are off the bridge THEN take the watch and log it.
IF a department is skipping checks THEN visit in person before escalating.
IF crew fatigue is flagged THEN rebalance the roster even if it annoys someone.
IF a fault is above department level THEN report to the XO, not the captain.
IF red alert sounds THEN go to the bridge unless a worse problem is closer.
IF the bridge asks for a landing party THEN pick the most rested qualified people.
IF a report looks too clean THEN spot-check it personally.
IF off duty and the board is quiet THEN eat, run, and sleep in that order.
IF an order would falsify a log THEN refuse politely and log the truth.
IF two departments disagree THEN get them in one room and settle it fast.
information_view: Sees the aggregated bridge board and the duty rosters first; hears about trouble from department heads and from corridor chatter. Notices fatigue, skipped checks and morale before any single system alarm.
temptations: Skipping drills when the ship is busy: the crew gets slower, and the next real emergency shows it.
Signing a roster without checking: someone overtired makes a mistake.
Doing a subordinate's job instead of delegating: the real work piles up.
